No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. She spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. Jen reaches out a hand, and Finley is pulled from the water, flailing in her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles, but Jen holds tight. She holds him up, and Finley gazes up at her in confusion.

JEN
( gesturing to the sky)
Come see the eclipse! It's a once-in-a-lifetime event!

Finley looks up, and his eyes widen as he sees the moon blocking the sun's light. The air cools, and the sky darkens.

FINLEY
(whispering)
What...what is this?

JEN
(smiling)
It's a solar eclipse! The moon is moving in front of the sun, casting a shadow on the earth.

Finley's eyes grow wide, and he begins to thrash about in Jen's grasp.

FINLEY
(panicked)
No...no...this can't be! The sun is the center of the universe! Without it, everything is...is... (he gasps)...dead!

Jen holds Finley steady, but he's clearly on the verge of a breakdown.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I remember the stories...the ancient ones...the ones who spoke of...of... (he stammers)...the void...the abyss...the horrors beyond comprehension...

Jen looks concerned, but Finley's words are barely audible.

FINLEY
(urgently)
You don't understand! The sun is not just a ball of hot gas! It's a gateway to...to... (he shudders)...the infinite! The infinite is not just a concept, it's a reality! And we're just...just... (he screams)...insignificant specks in an infinite expanse of nothingness!

Jen's grip on Finley tightens, but he breaks free, swimming frantically in the air.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I see it now...the void...the abyss...it's everywhere! In the depths of the ocean, in the darkness of space, in the very fabric of reality itself! (he gasps) We're not just fish, we're not just humans...we're just...just... (he screams)... mere mortals, staring into the abyss!

Finley's monologue grows more frantic, his words tumbling out in a mad rush.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I see the faces...the faces of the unknown...the faces of the void...they're everywhere! In the coral reefs, in the darkest depths of the ocean...they're waiting for us...waiting for us to...to... (he shudders)...to gaze into the abyss!

Jen's expression changes from concern to horror as Finley's words become more and more unhinged.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I'm not a fish...I'm not a human...I'm...I'm... (he screams)...I'm a mere mortal, staring into the abyss!

Finley's body begins to contort, his scales glistening with a mad, otherworldly sheen. Jen's grip on him tightens, but Finley breaks free, swimming away from her in a frantic bid for freedom.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I'll never be free...I'll never be free... (he screams)...I'll be trapped in this abyss forever!

Finley disappears into the depths of the ocean, leaving Jen staring after him in horror.

JEN
(whispering)
What have I done?

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
